notes.title: We Are Live!!!, so what now?
notes.notes:
so we launched the game yesterday with reports of people enjoying the game and people complaining about bugs which is acceptable as this is a early access build of the game, so what now? the priority is to start polishing the game for the community so we need your help. please give as many suggestions, bug fixes and as much information as you can i will personalty do my best to include as much of the communities feed back in the finished product. thank you for embracing this project i will regularly check the community tab for your suggestions. :)

yours sincerely Cameron
